details.publicNotes:
Most cactopies are patient creatures that prize contemplation. They spend most of their time sunbathing and absorbing water and nutrients from the ground. While they enjoy solitary meditation, cactopies also appreciate conversations about philosophy. It's typical for a gathering of cactopies to remain quiet for long periods, punctuated by a poetical statement from one of its members that the others then reflect upon.

Between these tranquil times, cactopies experience bursts of energy and enthusiasm, during which they venture out in search of new experiences, traveling as fast as their eight roots can carry them. Though meditating cactopies might find their active brethren exhausting, they recognize the value these periods hold for bringing new ideas to their communities.

Though they superficially resemble cacti, cactopies maintain an almost perfect spherical shape, topped with a single large flower that emits a pleasant fragrance. While this fragrance does an excellent job of drawing in pollinators, it also muddles the minds of sapient creatures, often inspiring them to a noisy sort of violence that cactopies detest.

When threatened, cactopies defend themselves with their long roots and their numerous fast-growing spines. They can also shower threats with hallucinogenic pollen from their flower, which inflicts them with a deep-seated fear of the cactopies' piercing spines.

Collected Works

On occasion, the cactopie's fabled wisdom inspires an ambitious scribe to seek a colony of cactopies and record their sage words. While many such works have been started, few have been completed. For one thing, cactopie conversation flows at a pace most creatures find intolerably slow, and much of it is composed of replies to questions posed decades before. It's also difficult to complete a book when every stray gust of wind brings the threat of inhaling a whiff of cactopie perfume, causing you to run amok and destroy your manuscript in the process.

A creature entering or starting its turn in the cactopie's aura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:19] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round. A creature who succeeds at the save becomes temporarily immune to curious aroma for 1 minute.

Requirements The cactopie has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} in one of their roots

Effect The cactopie attempts to pull the creature in and smash it against their spiny body. The creature attempts a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is moved to a square adjacent to the cactopie of the cactopie's choice. This is forced movement.

Failure As success, but the creature also takes @Damage[(2d4+2)[piercing]] damage.

Critical Failure As success, but the creature also takes @Damage[(4d4+4)[piercing]] damage and @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]] damage.

The cactopie unleashes a cloud of toxic pollen from their flower in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20]. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:19] save. Creatures that are frightened from Pollen Burst gain weakness to piercing 5 for as long as they remain frightened. The cactopie can't use Pollen Burst again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Pollen Burst]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
